text:
This issue occurs because older versions of Hermes Agent required a remote API key to pass activation gates, even when configured with a local Honcho URL.

### Solution

Upgrade your Hermes Agent installation by running:

```bash
hermes update
```

Starting in release **`v2026.3.30`+**, Hermes Agent accepts a `base_url` without requiring a remote key and automatically injects a `"local"` placeholder API key when connecting to local endpoints (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, or `::1`).
